sloka: ततो हनूमानुत्प्लुत्य हयांत्रिशिरसस्तदा।विददार नखैः क्रुद्धो गजेन्द्रं मृगराडिव ।। ६.७०.३७ ।।
transliteration: tato hanūmānutplutya hayāṁtriśirasastadā।vidadāra nakhaiḥ kruddho gajendraṁ mṛgarāḍiva ।। 6.70.37 ।।

translations.english: Then Hanuman also jumped up in anger and tore the horse off Trisira just as the lion would tear the lordly elephant with nails.
